mechanisms.detail: finite total-view coverage, uniqueness, surjectivity, finality, normal completion, allocation separation, and unmodeled-observable-write rejection are compiler-verified PLIRON structural facts. ProductionTotalOutputStagingReportV2 carries them inertly; staging alone grants no functional-refinement authority
exactly-once atomic contribution coverage; this does not prove the reduction operator, order, or final fold value
closed typed scalar SSA with exact type, operator, cast, overflow, domain, rounding, exceptional-value, and commitment validation; IEEE operator congruence is not target IEEE-value authority

finite fold, bounded recurrence, and permutation-gather contracts receive structural validation of domains, step bounds, order, numerical policy, typed roots, and coverage binding. Their final-value formulas are not replayed by the aggregate checker and fail closed with UnsupportedFormulaReplayRole

the compiler retains the exact safe CPU input[index] bounds assertion and reconciles scalar, view, index, allocation origin, and stride with the ranked GPU load. Full-domain discharge accepts an exact identical symbolic ranked extent or an overflow-checked bounded static affine interval, including an empty domain. Unrelated dynamic extents, missing or unused assertions, unsafe intervals, and arithmetic overflow fail closed; ordinary independent slice lengths therefore remain unsupported

canonical dynamic unit-step loops carry the exact compiler-derived finite-domain symbol, full u64 machine bound, transition, termination variant, maximum-step identity, and overflow-safe final latch. Noncanonical SCCs produce exact invariant/variant proof requests, but imported answers cannot yet compose with aggregate authority

ErrorBounded sites bind actual and reference roots, domain and precondition formulas, finite absolute and relative bounds, the ranked graph, and MIR subjects. Aggregate finite-error-formula theorem replay is not implemented, so ErrorBounded remains fail closed; test epsilons, reassociation assumptions, or receipts do not grant authority

compiler-derived cooperative-tensor checks validate instruction identity, typed fragment roles, lane coordinates, convergence, tail policy, staging, and publication. Exact lhs, rhs, accumulator, and result roots survive ranked PLIRON materialization; bounded whole-function dataflow rejects incompatible producer joins and consumer ABIs. Typed result components bind the propagated result layout, component ordinals, scalar policies, and output stores to the safe-reference obligation at the claim boundary. Tensor-component formula replay is not implemented and remains fail closed

multiple separated point outputs retain one compiler-owned staged role binding per output. PLIRON independently proves and reconciles distinct output views, allocation separation, output-specific TotalView and hierarchy facts, frames, schedules, and ordered-product identity. One generated Verus run replays each supported exact output formula, but does not replay the separated product. Staging alone grants no authority; the private move-only join requires both structural and formula reports

one generated per-compilation Verus run is the only external formula proof execution. It independently replays each supported exact pointwise integer or compiler-side IEEE operator-DAG coordinate, domain, precondition, and value formula without a generic relation premise. PLIRON separately proves and reconciles total coverage, separation, frames, schedules, and ordered-product identity. Inert total-output and per-output staging grant no authority; the private move-only join is the admission authority and requires both result classes. ErrorBounded, tensor-component, fold, recurrence, permutation, and noncanonical-loop roles fail closed until exact formula replay is implemented

compiler-owned semantic derivation binds safe-reference MIR, kernel MIR, live PLIRON, typed SSA, canonical loops, and every total output. Unsupported loop SCCs retain exact entries, backedges, exits, guards, transitions, carried values, and ranked evidence in a proof request; that request is not aggregate authority

before KIR lowering, one generated Verus checker is the only external formula proof execution and independently replays each supported exact pointwise formula. PLIRON, not the generated checker, proves and reconciles total coverage, allocation separation, and the ordered output product. The Verus report binds its exact instantiation, status-Checked policy-staging inputs, tool execution, MIR, live PLIRON, and SafeReferenceMirToLivePliron identity; the private move-only join is the admission authority and requires matching structural and formula results. Unsupported replay roles fail closed and the fixed production runtime remains mandatory
